# Intel Macs only. Everything else installs from requirements-lock.txt.
#
# onnxruntime -- the engine the narration voice runs on -- stopped publishing
# macOS wheels for Intel after 1.23.2. Every release from 1.24.1 onward is
# Apple Silicon only. So an Intel build cannot use the version the other
# platforms use, and pip --require-hashes will not fall back to anything.
#
# 1.23.2 is the last release that works there. kokoro-onnx asks for
# onnxruntime>=1.20.1, so it is satisfied, and OSV reports no advisories
# against it.
#
# Resolved for one platform deliberately, since that is the whole point:
#
#     uv pip compile --python-platform x86_64-apple-darwin #        --python-version 3.13 --generate-hashes --no-header #        requirements-intel-mac.in -o requirements-intel-mac.txt
#
# When onnxruntime stops being installable here at all, or Intel Macs stop
# mattering, delete this file and the macos-15-intel entry in the build
# workflow together.
